title: fix(cli): verify keys before storing credentials
author: ismailbanouigu

gist.summary: Direct `polli auth login` keys are now checked through `/account/key` before credentials are stored. Invalid or unverifiable keys produce a non-zero exit without replacing the existing login. The optional profile lookup still runs after key validation, and regression tests cover rejected and verified keys.
